edges.description: Graphiti Fractal is a Velantrim project family covering product and bounded research-laboratory memory/retrieval work.
The product repository is the source to reopen for current Graphiti Fractal product code and authorization state.
The laboratory repository isolates bounded experiments so research evidence is not silently promoted into the product repository.
The lab researches Graphiti Fractal-related behavior, but lab evidence does not authorize or imply product/runtime changes in the product repository.
The retrieval relevance thread is a bounded research branch inside the laboratory, focused on candidate relevance and qualification rather than storage persistence alone.
The Drive document preserves the most detailed human-readable discussion and rationale explaining how FM-13 through FM-16 evolved.
The Notion research track is the current human/AI route for status and navigation without replacing exact executable evidence.
The Atlas child directory explains which source to open for metrics, current status, detailed history, or broader ecosystem placement.
The GitHub reasoning log preserves the technical hypothesis evolution and reviewer-driven interpretation corrections alongside source-controlled research history.
The FM-16 closure document contains the reconciled bounded interpretation of run_007 and explicitly records what was and was not established.
Frozen run_007 artifacts are the preferred source for exact FM-16 numerical evidence rather than relying on a narrative summary.
The closure interprets and reconciles the frozen run_007 evidence but remains subordinate to the artifacts for exact executable facts.
